description:
🪔✨ 3 Amazing Diwali DIY & Home Decoration Ideas! 🤯

Aaj ki video mein dekhiye 3 creative DIY ideas, jinse simple cardboard, plastic spoons aur cement ko use karke beautiful Diwali decorations aur unique crafts bana sakte hain! 🎨🏠

✨ Number 1: Cardboard par glue se melted candle jaisa design banao. Sukhne ke baad yellow aur golden color se paint karo aur upar wick add karke bana lo giant Diwali candle decoration! 🕯️💛

✨ Number 2: Plastic spoons ko cut karke cardboard ke round pieces par chipkao. Cement aur iron wire ki help se tree shape design banao, yellow color karo aur diya add karke ready karo beautiful Diwali decoration! 🌳🪔✨

✨ Number 3: Ek small bottle aur white cement ki help se mushroom-shaped design banao. Sukhne ke baad ise cute decorative pot ki tarah use kar sakte hain! 🍄🪴

⚠️ Cement, iron wire aur cutting tools ke saath safety ka dhyan rakhein. Real flame ko cardboard aur plastic decorations se door rakhein.
